design_philosophy: Spiritual, Calm, Minimal, Premium. Generous whitespace, serene typography, soft lighting, and gentle transitions.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise/grain overlay. opacity-5 or opacity-10 maximum.
visual_enhancers.motifs: Use Om (ॐ) subtly with low opacity (opacity-5 to opacity-10) or soft glow in backgrounds. Swastik as very light decorative element or watermark. Absolutely no rotation on motifs.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #EFEBE3. Subtle ornamental borders sparingly for section dividers.
visual_enhancers.animations: Smooth, slow, meditative. Fade-in, soft transitions only (duration-700 to duration-1000). Avoid bouncy or snappy motion.

components_instructions.hero_slider: Full width hero slideshow. Auto-rotating every 5s with fade transition. MUST include a dark overlay (bg-black/30 to bg-black/40) for text legibility. Hero text center-aligned for premium feel.
components_instructions.activities_carousel: Amazon-style center carousel. Main activity in center (fully visible), side items partially visible (scaled down or lower opacity). Smooth horizontal sliding.
components_instructions.about_section: 2-column layout (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2). Video embed (admin-uploaded) on left with soft gold border, rich text on right.
components_instructions.history_section: Centered, narrow reading column (max-w-3xl) for rich Hindi narrative text. Drop caps or decorative initial letters recommended.
components_instructions.gallery: Strict 3x3 grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6). Pagination controls below. Lightbox integration on image click. Hover effect: slow scale (hover:scale-105) with fade.
components_instructions.contact_form: Minimalist inputs with 1px border. Google Map embed full width above or beside form. Submit button in Saffron (#E86A33).
components_instructions.donation_page: Split view: Razorpay payment form on left (Shadcn customized forms), UPI QR on right (card layout with gold accent border).
components_instructions.navigation: Sticky header with glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80). ALWAYS in English. Tri-lingual language switcher (Hindi, English, Sanskrit) as a subtle dropdown.
components_instructions.dashboard: Clean, dense 'Control Room' grid (Archetype 4 structural feel but keeping the light palette). Shadcn tables for donations, form for video/gallery uploads.

hero_images.description: Ancient hindu temple architecture, majestic angle

instructions_to_main_agent.icons: Use lucide-react. Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, and forms.
instructions_to_main_agent.language: Use i18next or a React Context for Tri-lingual content (Hindi, English, Sanskrit). The UI structure should default to Hindi strings in body but keep English strings in Navigation. E.g. navLinks = ['Home', 'About', 'History', 'Gallery', 'Contact', 'Donate'].
instructions_to_main_agent.theming: Strictly implement the color palette. Backgrounds MUST be the light cream/white variants. No heavy red blocks. Red should be reserved for typography highlights or subtle borders.
instructions_to_main_agent.layout: Follow mobile-first padding. Generous whitespace is critical (p-6, p-12). Images should not exceed 80vh on mobile. Grid items must be direct children of grid containers.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, nav links, forms, language switcher) MUST have unique `data-testid` attributes (kebab-case, role-based).
